decision_reason: AION already exposes an active PREPROD Product Factory and active delivery/fulfillment compatibility layers. Legacy item 130 therefore does not justify a second Product Factory or new generic delivery engine. CEREBRO should preserve and wrap the existing capability.

live_observation.source: AION WordPress live plugin inventory via authenticated read-only connector

product_factory.name: AION Product Factory
product_factory.description_contract: Zero-added-cost deterministic product runtime for AION Operator. PREPROD-first and PROD-denied in V0.

reuse_seams.name: CEREBRO Bundle Commerce Bridge V0
reuse_seams.evidence: Reuses Product Factory order/artifact/delivery primitives without enabling public checkout or real sales.

reuse_seams.name: CEREBRO Bundle Fulfillment Adapter V0
reuse_seams.evidence: PREPROD-only fulfillment adapter that wraps existing proven runtimes and creates no public checkout or real charges.

reuse_seams.name: AION Customer Zero-Payment Test V1
reuse_seams.evidence: PREPROD customer-journey simulator exercises purchase -> fulfillment -> welcome/access email -> private result with zero real payment.

reuse_seams.name: AION Customer Experience Quality Gate V1
reuse_seams.evidence: PREPROD evidence gate covers customer email, private delivery and customer-facing UX.

supported_facts: AION Product Factory, PRODMAN and PORTFOLIO already exist and must not be duplicated.
Private delivery already exists for P001/P002/P003 using token, expiry, artifact download and refund revocation.
Legacy item 130 automatic delivery belongs to Product Factory and requires completion/reuse, not a new engine.

residuals: Any future real customer delivery or PROD side effect remains under its own promotion, policy and physical-E2E gates.
This audit proves reuse/absorption of the legacy capability; it does not promote AION commerce or delivery to PROD.
rollback: Remove this additive audit record and the item-130 overlay row; historical reconciliation remains untouched.
rebuild: Re-run the authenticated read-only AION plugin inventory, verify Product Factory plus delivery/fulfillment reuse seams remain active, and regenerate this record without executing customer delivery.
